But they just want estimate. So we can compute cost. Also maybe need to add insurance? Not specified. So just cost.

We need to call get_flight_cost. But we need travel_from and travel_to codes. We need to get list of airports first. So call list_all_airports. Then parse first and last. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount.

Let's call list_all_airports.
